comments: Two-consecutive-frame temporal stacking (nb_input_channels=2, stem concat -- KuRALSDataset's existing n_frames windowing, MAX_SCAN_GAP=6, no dataloader changes needed) on top of the best result so far (finetune, 0.3684 val dice). Adds genuinely new information (motion/consistency across frames) rather than reorganizing the same per-frame information the way every architecture variant did. Initialized via kurals/expand_stem_channels.py, which duplicates the native checkpoint's single-frame stem filter into both channels and halves stem.pw's weights so two identical frames exactly reproduce the native single-frame forward pass at init (verified: max abs diff 0.01 vs native, i.e. only quantization rounding) -- everything past the stem transfers unchanged. Single try as requested; not worth pursuing further if it underperforms the 0.3684 finetune baseline.
